# Sum of Values at Indices With K Set Bits.

@example Places 3 (11), 5 (101) and 6 (110) have two 1 digits each: 4 + 6 + 2 = 12.
[7,3,9,4,8,6,2]
2
=> 12

@example Only place 0 has no 1 digit at all.
[20,11,13]
0
=> 20

@example The places are 0 to 3, and none of them has three 1 digits in binary.
[6,2,9,5]
3
=> 0

# A single value: k = 0 takes it, k = 1 leaves nothing.
[100000]
0
=> 100000

[5]
1
=> 0

1
=> 21

1
=> 20

=> 0

=> 40
